decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted Design and Access statement, PA 00, PA 02, PA 03, PA 04, PA 05, PA 06 received 27/10/2011, PA 07 rev A received 28/11/2011, PA 07  rev B received 20/01/2012, BS4142 Environmental Assessment received 05/12/2011and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried out outside of the hours of 10.00 and 22.00, Monday to Sunday.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the shop front shall have a minimum clear width of at least 0.9m, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - The scheme of extract ventilation shown on the approved drawings and detailed within the Environmental Assessment shall be carried out before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.
description: Change of use of the premises from A1 (Shop) to mixed A1 and A5 (Hot Food Takeaway) use, shop front alterations and installation of an extractor flue and cladding to the rear of the premises.
